$\boxed{\textbf{Diode}}$

::: {style="text-align:center"}
```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[>=latex]
\foreach \x in {0.25,0.75,...,3.75} {
    \draw (\x,-0.25) circle[radius=0.2cm];
    \draw (\x,-0.75) circle[radius=0.2cm];
}
\foreach \x in {0.25,0.75,...,1.75} {
    \node at (\x,-0.25) {$-$};
    \node at (\x,-0.75) {$-$};
    \draw ({\x+0.2},-0.45) circle[radius=0.05cm];
    \draw ({\x+0.2},-0.95) circle[radius=0.05cm];
}
\foreach \x in {2.25,2.75,...,3.75} {
    \node at (\x,-0.25) {$+$};
    \node at (\x,-0.75) {$+$};
    \draw ({\x+0.15},-0.45) -- ({\x+0.225},-0.45);
    \draw ({\x+0.15},-0.95) -- ({\x+0.225},-0.95);
}
\draw[green!50!black,->] (2.2,-0.3) -- (1.8,-0.3);
\draw[green!50!black,->] (2.2,-0.5) -- (1.8,-0.5);
\draw[green!50!black,->] (2.2,-0.7) -- (1.8,-0.7);
\node[above,green!50!black] at (2,0) {$\Vec{E}$};
\draw[red,loosely dashed] (1.5,0.5) -- (1.5,-1.5);
\draw[red,loosely dashed] (2.5,0.5) -- (2.5,-1.5);
\node[above,red] at (2,0.5) {depletion layer};
\draw (0,0) rectangle (4,-1);
\draw[blue] (2.2,0.25) arc (270:290:5);
\node[right,blue] at (4,0.75) {barrier potential};
\node[right,blue] at (4,0.25) {$=0.7\,V$ (silicon)};
\node at (-0.5,-1.25) {B${}^-$};
\draw[loosely dashed] (-0.5,-1.25) circle[radius=0.4cm];
\node at (4.5,-1.25) {P${}^+$};
\draw[loosely dashed] (4.5,-1.25) circle[radius=0.4cm];
\node[below] at (1,-1) {P};
\node[below] at (3,-1) {N};
\node[below,orange!50!black] at (2,-1) {$e^-$};
\node[below,orange!50!black] at (2,-1.5) {p--n junction};
\node[below,orange!50!black] at (0,-2) {$\Vec{F} = q \cdot \Vec{E}$};
\end{tikzpicture}
```

\draw[green!50!black,->] (2.2,-0.7) -- (1.8,-0.7);

\draw[red,loosely dashed] (1.5,0.5) -- (1.5,-1.25);
\draw[red,loosely dashed] (2.5,0.5) -- (2.5,-1.25);
\node[below] at (1,-1) {P};
\node[below] at (3,-1) {N};

\draw (0,-0.5) -- (-1,-0.5) -- (-1,-2) -- (1.8,-2);
\draw (1.8,-1.75) -- (1.8,-2.25);
\draw (1.95,-1.9) -- (1.95,-2.1);
\draw (2.1,-1.75) -- (2.1,-2.25);
\draw (2.25,-1.9) -- (2.25,-2.1);
\draw (2.25,-2) -- (5,-2) -- (5,-0.5) -- (4,-0.5);
\node[above] at (2,-1.75) {$V_e$};
\node[above] at (1.5,-2) {${}_+$};
\node[above] at (2.5,-2) {${}_-$};
\draw[->,red] (-1.25,-0.875) arc (180:140:1);
\node[red,left] at (-1.25,-0.5) {$I$};
\draw[->,orange!50!black] (-0.5,-0.75) arc (140:180:1);
\node[orange!50!black,right] at (-0.7,-1) {$e^-$};
\end{tikzpicture}

if $V_e > 0.7\,V$,<br>
$e^-$ passes through the depletion layer. <span style="color:red">(Conduct)</span>

:::

Base: thin and lightly doped.

Emitter: heavily doped.

Collector: intermediately doped.

::: {style="color:green"}
<ul style="list-style-type: '① ';">
<li><span style="color:green">Apply $V_{\mathrm{BE}} > 0.7\,V$, $e^-$ flow into base<span></li>
</ul>

<ul style="list-style-type: '② ';">
<li>
<span style="color:green">Very few $e^-$ will stay in base, </span><span style="color:red">(lightly doped)</span><br>
<span style="color:green">most $e^-$ will flow to collector. </span><span style="color:red">(thin)</span>
</li>
</ul>

<ul style="list-style-type: '③ ';">
<li><span style="color:green">With $V_{\mathrm{CE}}>0$, $e^-$ will flow out. <span><span style="color:red">(current)</span></li>
</ul>
:::

<ul style="list-style-type: '① ';">
<li>When $V_{\mathrm{GS}} = 0$, JFET is ON.</li>
</ul>

<ul style="list-style-type: '② ';">
<li>When $V_{\mathrm{GS}} < 0$, depletion layer expands. $I=0$. <span style="color:red">(OFF)</span></li>
</ul>

:::

::: {.column style="color:red"}
\usepackage{cancel}
\begin{align*}
    \quad \frac{V_i-V_0}{\color{blue}\cancel{\color{red} L}} \color{red} \cdot t_{\mathrm{on}} &= \frac{V_0}{\color{blue}\cancel{\color{red} L}} \cdot t_{\mathrm{off}} \\
    \quad (V_i-V_0) D \cdot \color{blue}\cancel{\color{red} T_s} &= V_0 \cdot (1-D) \color{blue}\cancel{\color{red} T_s}\\
    D \cdot V_i &= V_0
\end{align*}
:::
::::

$\displaystyle L \cdot \frac{di_L}{dt} = 0-V_0 \implies \frac{di_L}{dt} = -\frac{V_0}{L}$
